scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An ailing Lazarus lies awake in bed as two women tend to him in a sunlit stone room; village buildings are visible through an open doorway.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: John 11:1 identifies Lazarus as ailing and from Bethany, the village of Mary and her sister Martha. The bedside scene, the sisters' presence and care, and the setting are imaginative details.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Mary kneels beside Jesus and wipes his bare foot with her long hair beside an open jar of oil, while a man rests in bed in the background of a warmly lit room.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: John 11:2 identifies Mary as the woman who anointed the Lord with fragrant oil and wiped his feet with her hair, and says that her brother Lazarus was sick. This imaginative scene brings those details together; the verse does not say they happened in the same room or at the same time.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Two worried sisters speak to a departing messenger at a stone house while a sick man rests on a bed inside.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of the sisters sending word to the Lord that the one he loves is sick. The messenger, house, and gestures are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with a concerned woman outside a stone home while an ill man rests on a bed inside.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative setting for Jesus' words in John 11:4: after hearing about the sickness, he says it is not unto death but for God's glory, so that the Son of God may be glorified through it. The woman, home, and bedside scene are artistic choices, not details specified in this verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits with Martha, her sister, and Lazarus in a sunlit stone courtyard, resting a hand on Lazarus's shoulder as the group smiles together.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: John 11:5 says Jesus loved Martha, her sister, and Lazarus. This imagined gathering expresses that love; the verse does not specify a meeting or setting.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits on a cushioned bench in a sunlit courtyard, listening to a kneeling visitor. Two small stones lie side by side between them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects John 11:6 and the excerpt's Berean Interlinear glosses: Jesus hears that someone is sick and remains where he is for two days. The visitor and courtyard are imagined, and the two stones suggest the two days.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures as he walks with five disciples along a sunlit hillside path, with a village and mountains in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 11:7, where Jesus tells his disciples to go into Judea again, as reflected in the Berean Interlinear word glosses. The setting, gestures, and appearance are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus listens to concerned disciples on a rocky path as one gestures toward a distant town.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of the disciples asking their Rabbi whether he is going there again after the Jews had recently sought to stone him. The setting and gestures are artistic interpretations of John 11:8, informed by its Berean Interlinear glosses.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures toward a sunlit, stony path as a traveler with a walking staff walks beside him; hills and a village lie in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene inspired by Jesus' words about the twelve hours of daylight and walking without stumbling while seeing the light of this world. The traveler and setting are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler stumbles over a stone on a rocky path among olive trees at night, with a moonlit village in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a person stumbling while walking at night, reflecting the verse’s words that the light is not in him.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks to attentive disciples on a sunlit path, gesturing toward a distant village among hills and olive trees.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus telling his companions that their friend Lazarus has fallen asleep and that he is going to awaken him, as described in John 11:11.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus walks with disciples along a sunlit path as one gestures while speaking to him; olive trees and a distant village fill the warm landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the disciples speaking to the Lord about the hope that the one who has fallen asleep will get well. The setting and gestures are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks to thoughtful disciples on a sunlit path, with a stone burial place in the distant hillside.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests the contrast in John 11:13: Jesus spoke of a man’s death, while his listeners understood him to be speaking of the rest of sleep.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks solemnly to a group of attentive companions beneath a tree in a sunlit, rocky landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus plainly telling them that Lazarus has died, as expressed by the verse and its Berean Interlinear token glosses. The setting and the listeners’ appearance are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures toward a distant village as four attentive disciples walk with him along a sunlit road among olive trees and hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus encouraging his disciples to go with him, reflecting the verse's words about rejoicing for their sake so that they may believe.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Thomas gestures toward a figure on a sunlit path as his fellow disciples listen with concern and resolve.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Thomas, called Didymus, urging his fellow disciples to go too, even if they may die with him; the setting and gestures are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus listens to a grieving woman who gestures toward a rock-cut tomb with a partially open entrance and wilted flowers nearby.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus arriving and learning that the man had already been in the tomb four days. The figures, setting, and visible tomb entrance are artistic choices; the verse does not specify these details.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A small stone village among olive trees overlooks a winding path toward a walled city across sunlit hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative landscape illustrates John 11:18, which places Bethany near Jerusalem, about fifteen stadia away; it is not a map of their exact geography.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Two grieving women sit together in a sunlit courtyard as visitors gather around them with gestures of comfort.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects John 11:19, where many Jewish visitors came to Martha and Mary to console them concerning their brother. The setting and gestures are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Martha meets Jesus on a sunlit stone path outside a house, while Mary sits inside the open doorway.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of John 11:20: Martha meets Jesus after hearing he is coming, while Mary sits in the house. The setting and appearances are artistic interpretations.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A sorrowful Martha speaks with an outstretched hand to Jesus, who listens beside a stone path among olive trees and village buildings.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Martha speaking to Jesus about her brother's death in John 11:21; the setting and gestures are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman gestures as she speaks with Jesus on a sunlit path near an ancient village, surrounded by trees, stone walls, and wildflowers.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a conversation inspired by John 11:22, expressing confidence that God will give what is asked of him. The setting and gestures are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits on a stone wall and speaks with an open hand to a tearful woman seated across from him on a sunlit village path.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus telling a woman that her brother will rise again in John 11:23; the setting and gestures are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Martha speaks earnestly to a seated man in an ancient landscape, with a tomb and a golden dawn behind them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Martha expressing her confidence that he will rise in the resurrection on the last day; the dawn suggests her future hope.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with a woman beneath a tree amid stones and green plants, with a sunlit hillside village in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus speaking to a woman, with morning light and new growth suggesting his words about resurrection and life in John 11:25.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with an attentive woman beneath an olive tree in a sunlit garden, with a path leading toward distant hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests Jesus’ question about belief and the promise of enduring life in John 11:26; the garden and distant path are artistic details.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman with her hand over her heart speaks to Jesus as they sit beside a sunlit path among olive trees and distant village houses.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the woman's confession that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, who is coming into the world, in John 11:27.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman leans close to speak privately to Mary, who listens in a sunlit home.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 11:28, where a woman privately tells her sister Mary that the Teacher has come and calls her.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman rises and hurries along a sunlit path toward a man in the distance, while another woman sits beside a stone house.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 11:29: after hearing, she rises quickly and comes toward him. The setting and appearances are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus and Martha sit together beneath a tree on a rocky path outside a distant village, speaking with serious, compassionate expressions.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus remaining outside the village at the place where Martha had met him; the setting and gestures are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Mary hurries from a stone house as concerned mourners follow her into the sunlight.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 11:31: those comforting Mary follow her after she rises and leaves, supposing she is going to the tomb to weep.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Mary kneels at Jesus’ feet on a sunlit village path, looking up at him through tears as he looks down at her.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 11:32: Mary falls at Jesus’ feet and speaks to him in grief about her brother’s death. The setting and appearance are artistic interpretations.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus looks with a troubled expression toward a seated, weeping woman and the grieving people gathered around her in a sunlit Judean landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 11:33: Jesus sees the woman and those who came with her weeping and is deeply moved in spirit and troubled.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands with grieving people as a man gestures along a path toward a rock-cut entrance in a sunlit hillside.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 11:34: Jesus asks where he was laid, and those with Him invite Him to come and see. The setting and gestures are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits beneath a tree with his head bowed and tears on his face, overlooking a sunlit landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus weeping in John 11:35; the landscape and pose are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A grieving man sits with his face in his hands while four onlookers speak and watch with compassion near a rocky tomb.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of onlookers recognizing a man's love, inspired by John 11:36; the setting and gestures are artistic interpretations.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Grieving people speak with questioning expressions to Jesus beside a rock-hewn tomb, with a shrouded figure in the background.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects the question in John 11:37: whether the one who opened the eyes of the blind could also have kept this man from dying.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus approaches a rocky cave tomb with a solemn expression; a large stone rests against its entrance in a sunlit landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 11:38, where Jesus comes to the cave tomb deeply moved and a stone lies against it.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures toward a large stone at a rock-cut tomb as Martha looks at him anxiously and nearby people move the stone.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus asking for the stone to be taken away and Martha expressing concern about the deceased after four days, as described in John 11:39.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with an attentive woman beneath a tree, with a sunlit village and hills in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus speaking to the woman about believing and seeing the glory of God; the setting and appearance are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus looks upward with hands raised as people stand nearby and move a large stone beside a rock-cut opening in a sunlit landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of John 11:41: the stone is taken away and Jesus lifts His eyes, thanking the Father for hearing Him. The setting and figures are artistic interpretations.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus looks upward in prayer with one hand raised as a crowd gathers around him among olive trees and sunlit stones.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus speaking so the surrounding crowd may believe that the One who hears him sent him, as expressed in John 11:42.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus calls toward a dark rock-cut tomb with one hand outstretched as onlookers watch in a sunlit landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of the moment in John 11:43 when Jesus cries out in a loud voice for Lazarus to come forth. The setting and figures are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A linen-wrapped man steps from a stone tomb as Jesus gestures toward him and nearby people look on in wonder.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 11:44: the man who had been dead comes forth wrapped in linen, and Jesus tells those present to unbind him and let him go. The setting and figures are interpretive.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Mary and a group of visitors look toward Jesus with wonder in a sunlit stone courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of the visitors who came to Mary and, having seen what Jesus did, believed in him in John 11:45. The setting and individual reactions are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A group of people speak earnestly to attentive Pharisees in a sunlit stone courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts some people telling the Pharisees what Jesus had done, as described in John 11:46. The setting, appearance, and gestures are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Chief priests and Pharisees gather around a table in a warmly lit stone chamber, discussing with concerned expressions as one man gestures.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the council in John 11:47, where the chief priests and Pharisees ask what to do because this man performs many signs.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Concerned leaders confer in a stone chamber as one gestures toward a distant teacher and listeners, with Roman soldiers watching from Jerusalem's walls.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene conveying the speakers' fear that, if belief in Him spreads, the Romans will come and take away their place and nation; it does not portray that feared outcome as having occurred.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A stern high priest in blue and gold robes gestures as he speaks to a group of men in a warmly lit stone chamber.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Caiaphas, the high priest that year, telling the others they know nothing in John 11:49. The setting and appearance are artistic interpretations.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A robed elder addresses seated elders, gesturing toward a solitary man standing before families and a sunlit town.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene presents the verse's statement that one man should die for the people so that the whole nation might not perish; the setting and figures are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A high priest speaks to a gathering in a sunlit stone courtyard, while Jesus stands among people in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting the high priest's prophecy that Jesus would die for the nation; the setting and figures are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: People of varied ages arrive along paths through sunlit hills and gather around Jesus, who welcomes them with open arms.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined gathering pictures John 11:52's words about the scattered children of God being gathered into one; it does not depict a specific event described in the verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Five robed men confer gravely around a table in a stone chamber, while a lone man walks away in sunlight beyond an arch.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the verse's account that from that day they took counsel together to kill him; the setting and figures are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits with disciples in a quiet stone courtyard, with a hill town and dry hills beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus staying with his disciples in Ephraim near the wilderness, as described in John 11:54. The courtyard and shared moment are artistic details.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Travelers wash at a stone basin as a crowd walks uphill toward the walls of Jerusalem in warm sunlight.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of people going up from the region to Jerusalem before Passover to purify themselves, as described in John 11:55. The washing and individual travelers are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Pilgrims stand together in a sunlit temple courtyard, talking and looking toward the entrance as others gather nearby.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the people in John 11:56 seeking Jesus and asking one another in the temple whether he would come to the feast.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Robed leaders address attentive townspeople in a sunlit stone courtyard, while one man watches the distant street.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene illustrates the chief priests and Pharisees giving orders to report where he was so that they might seize him; the verse does not describe this particular courtyard or gathering.
